verdict.rationale: Runpod documents its own agent-skills plugin that lets users ask a coding agent, in natural language, to create Pods, deploy Serverless endpoints, transfer files, and deploy code with Flash. It also ships two official MCP servers that connect AI tools and coding agents directly to Runpod resources. missing for 10: a natural-language interface native to the Runpod console rather than one that relies on an external coding agent, documentation of how far the natural-language commands reach beyond the listed operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Once installed, you can ask your agent to create Pods, deploy Serverless endpoints, transfer files, or deploy your own code with Flash, all in natural language.
Runpod provides two Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that connect AI tools and coding agents directly to Runpod
Manage Pods, endpoints, templates, volumes, and registries through the Runpod REST API.
